values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

note: DEC (Adirondacks), East Caroga Lake. Loops A-F, tight spacing, best for smaller rigs. Beach, boat launch. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident, phone 518-835-4241, ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max, no electric (now verified from the RA site list), 2027 opening May 14. Added 104 sites to 40 ft with pull-throughs, showers, dump. Season left as is (its manual note stands); for a human: DEC's 2026 summary closes Caroga Lake Sept 7 (Labor Day) and ReserveAmerica's 2027 season ends Sun Sep 5, so a closes of 09-05 is supportable. Note trimmed of site count/electric/length/booking. Not stated: water/sewer at sites.
